best.explanation: Baleal looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 169 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 76/100, and wind is the main risk.  A broad, forgiving beach setup with several peaks; this is best for spreading out and finding a manageable wave when the bay has enough push.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; 6-9s at mid tide is soft and sectiony on the Baleal sandbanks.

ranked.explanation: Rey Cortiço looks like a solid window for Heavy / advanced, Medium confidence: 1.2-1.5 m, 258 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 75/100, and wind is the main risk.  An open beach break where the sandbanks decide everything; this is best for quiet, punchy peaks when Lagide is too small; 6-9s at mid tide can turn Belgas punchy and rippable.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; Rey Cortiço is above your current comfort range.
